title: Cannot find function fillPage
description:
I have an Addin at a repo [here](https://github.com/homerhanumat/addinplots).  It works fine using a version of `shinygadgets` from a few days ago.  But using the current version I get this error:

```
>addinplots:::cloudplotAddin()
Error in tagList(fillPage(tags$div(class = "gadget-container", ...), title = title,  : 
  could not find function "fillPage"
```

title: Error installing shinygadeget
description:
I successfully installed `shinygadgets` on my own Debian Jesse machine a few days ago.  But on the same Debian set-up on Digital Ocean this evening I get:

```
Error : object ‘css’ is not exported by 'namespace:htmltools'
```
